content:
SpaceXAI and Cursor are merging into one company, but before the merger is finalized, the two companies have teamed up to launch a brand new iPhone and Mac app called Grok Bot.

According to SpaceXAI's announcement, Grok Bot is a brand new AI agent, which they describe as an "AI teammate you can hand off actual work to."

Each Bot will have its own computer, then log into the apps and services you're already using to help you handle your inbox and other tools.

SpaceXAI says Bots can complete entire workflows from start to finish, only coming to you when approval is needed.

The company says you can chat with Bots "as if you're talking to a colleague" — their agents will remember conversations, learn your preferences, and get better the longer you use them.

Grok Bot launches today in Beta on Mac and iOS, with the desktop version also supporting Windows and Linux, while Android is listed as "coming soon."

Initially only subscribers to SuperGrok Heavy, Cursor Ultra and Cursor Teams Premium can use it first.

For more details, check out the official announcement.

2026年8月21日：SpaceXAI expanded the scope of Grok Bot usage after 10 days.

Also, my colleague Fernando is a fan. SpaceXAI and Cursor have designed a fairly approachable agentic AI system this time — other companies really should take note.
